description: Answers "how long can I listen to 100 dB", "is 85 dB dangerous for 8 hours", "how long at a concert before hearing damage". Maximum daily safe exposure time for a sound level per NIOSH's recommended exposure limit: 85 dB(A) for 8 h, 3 dB exchange rate (88 dB → 4 h, 100 dB → 15 min). Input is a dB number; to get the dB of a named sound first, use lookup_sound_level.
name: safe_exposure_time

safe_duration_hours.description: NIOSH max daily exposure in hours; null when not applicable

title: Safe exposure time for a decibel level
